fixedWitness.text: Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the LORD’s word came, saying, “Israel shall be your name.”

wikipediaBodyRead.locator: Jacob article, infobox “Other name Israel” lines 233–236; lead lines 266–269
wikipediaBodyRead.support: The page identifies Jacob as Israel and as patriarch/forefather, supporting the exact individual referent; it also distinguishes the Israelites as descendants/collective, so a separate context variant is justified.
wikipediaBodyRead.reviewEvidence: Fresh body opened in current review; pinned WEB itself explicitly says twelve stones are for tribes of sons of Jacob and that Israel was the name given to Jacob.

findings: 1KI18:31 directly names Jacob and reports “Israel shall be your name”; the proposal’s individual referent is textually sound and must remain distinct from the base collective “Israel” at 1KI6:1 and throughout people uses.

The verse simultaneously mentions the twelve tribes of Jacob’s sons, so the person and collective readings coexist in a single verse. A context variant on existing ID person:israel_682 is appropriate if renderer/schema can preserve both without replacing collective base; do not introduce a new canonical ID.

Proposal has no source-sidecar/evidence file or current source/evidence hash binding; the base draftSHA in the proposal was compared against live draft and is recorded above. Before adoption, synchronize provenance and validate title/URL/source link fields.
